feeds.title: Nourishing Minimalism Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rachel Jones, a joyful space specialist and founder of NourishingMinimalism.com. Nourishing Minimalism is a blog created to help moms nourish their families by simplifying and embracing minimalism and real food.

feeds.title: Christian Minimalism
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Becca Ehrlich, aka The Christian Minimalist. I'm excited that you've found your way to this blog and that you're interested in learning more about Christian Minimalism. I want to share our Christian minimalism journey so that it could help others on their journey. I hope that this blog will help you as you refocus your life on what matters most.

feeds.title: Abundant Life With Less Blog
feeds.description: Abundant Life With Less provides hope that through owning less and adapting a rational, sustainable and personal form of minimalism, one might live more intentionally, with greater peace, purpose, joy and adventure.

feeds.title: Smallish Blog
feeds.description: I'm Dana. My family has been minimizing stuff and being purposeful with our time for several years, and let me tell you, it just keeps getting better. I am passionate about helping women who feel trapped by too much stuff and busy lives to find freedom in small. Less stuff, fewer obligations, less pressure, less mess, and you'll be pleased with the result. And I want to help you do that!
